aretomo_OutBin.help: The tomogram will be reconstructed with this integer binning factor, using the -OutBin parameter from AreTomo.

aretomo_VolZ.label: Tomogram thickness (in unbinned voxels):
aretomo_VolZ.help: The tomogram will be reconstructed to this thickness, using the -VolZ parameter from AreTomo.

aretomo_tiltcorrect_angle.label: Tilt Angle Offset:
aretomo_tiltcorrect_angle.help: The tilt angle (in degrees) to be offset. If set to a value larger than 180, AreTomo will search for the optimal value itself, otherwise the value specified here will be used.

do_aretomo2.label: Use AreTomo2?
do_aretomo2.help: Set to Yes to perform tilt series alignment using Shawn Zheng's AreTomo2.

do_aretomo_ctf.label: Also do CTF estimation?
do_aretomo_ctf.help: If set to Yes, AreTomo2 will also perform CTF estimation and any CTF information that was already present in the input STAR files will be overwritten. Note that when using this option, it is no longer necessary to run a CTF estimation job

do_aretomo_phaseshift.label: Also estimate phase shift?
do_aretomo_phaseshift.help: If set to Yes, AreTomo2 will also perform estimation of the phase shift (due to a phase plate) during CTF estimation.

do_aretomo_reconstruct.label: Reconstruct tomograms?
do_aretomo_reconstruct.help: If set to Yes, AreTomo2 will also perform tomogram reconstruction (the default is to use weighted backprojection, but you can use SART by providing the additional argument --aretomo_sart.

do_aretomo_tiltcorrect.label: Correct Tilt Angle Offset?
do_aretomo_tiltcorrect.help: Specify Yes to correct the tilt angle offset in the tomogram (applies the AreTomo -TiltCor option). This is useful for correcting slanting in tomograms which can arise due to sample mounting or milling angle. This can be useful for in situ data.

do_imod_fiducials.label: Use IMOD's fiducial based alignment?
do_imod_fiducials.help: Set to Yes to perform tilt series alignment using fiducials in IMOD.

do_imod_patchtrack.label: Use IMOD's patch-tracking for alignment?
do_imod_patchtrack.help: Set to Yes to perform tilt series alignment using patch-tracking in IMOD.

do_queue.label: Submit to queue?
do_queue.help: If set to Yes, the job will be submit to a queue, otherwise the job will be executed locally. Note that only MPI jobs may be sent to a queue. The default can be set through the environment variable RELION_QUEUE_USE.

do_skip_aretomo_align.label: Skip alignment and only reconstruct?
do_skip_aretomo_align.help: If set to Yes, AreTomo2 alignment (and CTF estimation) will be skipped, and only tomogram reconstruction will be performed. For this to work, tilt series alignment parameters need to be present in the input tiltseries STAR file. This allows AreTomo2 reconstructions from IMOD alignments.

fiducial_diameter.help: The diameter of the fiducials (in nm)

centre_proj.label: Central Z-slice (in binned pix):
centre_proj.help: This defines the central Z-slice of all Z-slices that will be summed to generate the 2D projection (in pixels in the tomogram). Zero means the middle (centre) of the tomogram.

ctf_intact_first_peak.label: Ignore CTFs until first peak?
ctf_intact_first_peak.help: When set to Yes, the lowest spatial frequencies will not be boosted through CTF-correction, which will lead to a reconstruction with less low-resolution contrast, but better high-resolution details>

do_fourier.label: Use Fourier-inversion?
do_fourier.help: When set to Yes, instead of using real-space backprojection, a Fourier-space inversion algorithm is used.

do_proj.label: Also write 2D sums of central Z-slices?:
do_proj.help: When set to Yes, this option will result in the calculation of 2D sums of Z-slices from the reconstructed tomograms. These may be useful to quickly screen for bad tomograms using the relion_display program.

do_queue.label: Submit to queue?
do_queue.help: If set to Yes, the job will be submit to a queue, otherwise the job will be executed locally. Note that only MPI jobs may be sent to a queue. The default can be set through the environment variable RELION_QUEUE_USE.

do_skip_wiener.label: Skip Wiener filter?
do_skip_wiener.help: By default, the Fourier-inversion method uses a Wiener-filter, where the signal-to-noise ratios are calculated from Fourier shell correlations between the odd/even frames, which should have thus been calculated during MotionCorrection. If this option is true, then the odd/even frames are not necessary, and the images will only be pre-calculated with the CTF, without any division by CTF^2 as in the Wiener filter. This is the option that should be used for subsequent (real) sub-tomogram averaging

generate_split_tomograms.label: Generate tomograms for denoising?:
generate_split_tomograms.help: Generate tomograms for input into a denoising job. For this option to work, Save images for denoising? should have been True during Motion Correction. Additionally, adjust zdim to minimise the amount of empty space without sample within the tomograms.

in_tiltseries.label: Input tilt series:
in_tiltseries.help: Input global tilt series star file.

min_dedicated.label: Minimum dedicated cores per node:
min_dedicated.help: Minimum number of dedicated cores that need to be requested on each node. This is useful to force the queue to fill up entire nodes of a given size. The default can be set through the environment variable RELION_MINIMUM_DEDICATED.

nr_mpi.label: Number of MPI procs:
nr_mpi.help: Number of MPI nodes to use in parallel. When set to 1, MPI will not be used. The maximum can be set through the environment variable RELION_MPI_MAX.

nr_threads.label: Number of threads:
nr_threads.help: Number of shared-memory (POSIX) threads to use in parallel. When set to 1, no multi-threading will be used. The maximum can be set through the environment variable RELION_THREAD_MAX.

other_args.help: In this box command-line arguments may be provided that are not generated by the GUI. This may be useful for testing developmental options and/or expert use of the program. cryocare_path.help:
